name: manual_2f0a58
claim: Port a self-improvement patch into the canonical skill and reference docs, never a managed thin wrapper, and review it against repo rules first: shared stash stack and merge-only git, existing tools and their safe defaults (for archives, hermes_portable_brain.py excludes secrets unless asked), and the OSSF-1 validator that rejects edits to a non-compliant canonical card. Leave the local wrapper to the installer refresh and say which of your own additions need human review.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-04: a Hermes self-improvement run patched a managed thin wrapper with workflow content and a hand-picked archive list that bundled secrets by default. The installer rewrites managed wrappers (created_by agent), so the patch would be lost, and the repo already had a portable archive tool whose safe default excludes secrets.
